prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Empire C02 science-fiction skill icon. One isolated genuine transparent RGBA cutout on a square 1254×1254 canvas, designed to read at actual 48×48 with center anchor [24,24].
Input roles: Image 1 is the exact original high-resolution skill-board slot and determines functional subject, component count, broad colors and action direction. Its magenta outside and any rectangular scene/card background must NOT be copied. Image 2 is the accepted C02 cargo-crate STYLE ONLY: imitate chunky simplified masses, confident heavy contour, broad matte planes and restrained cel-shaded values; do not copy crates, cargo hardware or the subject.
Style: Exaggerated chunky hand-drawn cartoon sci-fi shapes with thick stable dark contour and clear opaque material planes. Two or three value steps per material, few essential seams, tiny bounded highlights. Large functional forms instead of micro-panels, rivets, scratches or noise. No photorealism, glossy 3D, oil paint, dense edge wear or medieval gear with sci-fi glow stripes.
Composition: Preserve the original skill's functional motif in one tightly grouped, centered, easily recognized icon. The entire icon, including action glyphs, stays inside 6–8% empty transparent margins on all sides. No clipped tips. No text, logo, watermark, badge rim, rectangular background tile, decorative floor, cast shadow or UI panel.
Transparency: true transparent empty background and open gaps. All physical parts and action glyphs are opaque colored shapes. No painted checkerboard, white/magenta/black backdrop, mist, aura, broad glow, light bleed or colored fringe. Bounded action arrows and small waves may be bright, but must have clean hard edges and no exterior illumination. No programmatic alpha repair is intended.
Primary request: Rebuild 改接水路 / reroute water. Preserve ONE central round industrial valve/router at the intersection of FOUR broad water conduits, oriented up/down/left/right. Short chunky dark graphite and warm gray channel/pipe housings form a plus-shaped functional object with transparent corners around it. Inside are opaque cool teal water bands. A cyan routing stroke enters from the left with NO incoming arrowhead, then divides into exactly THREE broad outward arrowheads: UP, RIGHT and DOWN. The upper route is near-straight, the right/down path bends visibly around the central valve as in the source. Keep central hub visible and visually separate from arrows, with a single blue center and broad rim segments. The dark stone wall and entire square scene/card backdrop in the source must be omitted, while the four actual conduit stubs and valve are retained as the icon's meaningful mechanism. Arrows are clean opaque pale-cyan action glyphs, not glowing beams. No network nodes, circular magical aura, fifth pipe, faucet, extra labels, watery spray or backdrop.
